newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche up four pct after analysts meeting.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche up four pct after analysts meeting.

text.p: Shares in Germany's largest commercial bank Deutsche Bank AG rose over four percent in afternoon trade after its analysts' meeting in London on Wednesday.
Deutsche Bank shares were up 4.85 marks, or 4.08 percent, at 125.05 marks in late trade, while the IBIS DAX index set new records at 4,462.42 points, up 1.94 percent or 84.25.
Dealers said that the share benefited from an analysts' meeting. "The meeting seems to be over and the orders are coming in," one dealer said.
"The entire board with Rolf Breuer at the head presented themselves very well to the investment community," a dealer said.
